_doc: Module-specific FDPG labels for the 'proms' (Patient-Reported Outcome Measures) module. Targeted overrides where the canonical labels are too generic for PROMs context. Profile-specific nuance (BDI-II vs. PROMIS-29 etc.) is not captured here — those distinctions live in the profile title and the upstream profile-specific binding.

code.en_def: Code of the PROMs instrument or score type.

value[x].en_def: Result value of the PROMs item or score.

effective[x]:effectiveDateTime.de_def: Datum, an dem das PROMs-Instrument vom Patienten ausgefüllt wurde.
effective[x]:effectiveDateTime.en_def: Date when the PROMs instrument was completed by the patient.

derivedFrom.de_def: Verweis auf die QuestionnaireResponse, aus der dieser Score abgeleitet wurde.
derivedFrom.en_def: Reference to the QuestionnaireResponse this score is derived from.
